observed_in: Pet and Companion System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how companions develop over time, including their abilities, stats, and potential transformations. Variations can include static companions, those that gain experience and levels, or ones that evolve based on player choices or in-game events.
exclusion_criteria: Companions that remain static without any development.
Companions that are only temporary and do not impact the player's strategy over time.
inclusion_criteria: Companions can gain experience and level up.
Companions can evolve or change form based on player actions or events.
title: Companion Growth Dynamics
